questions.q: Does an approved requisition automatically become a purchase order?
options: Yes, approval and purchase order creation happen in the same step
No, it lands in a buyer's Process Requisitions worklist and must be processed into a purchase order
No, it is automatically cancelled once approved
Yes, but only for non-catalog requests
questions.explain: Approval alone does not create a purchase order - the requisition line moves to a buyer's worklist for processing.

questions.q: Why does Marcus mostly just confirm the supplier for Dana's bearing line instead of performing full sourcing?
options: Because sourcing is never required in Oracle Fusion Cloud
Because Dana already contacted Meridian directly herself
Because the catalog entry already carries Meridian Bearing Supply Co. as the negotiated source
Because sourcing can only be done by a requester, never a buyer
questions.explain: Catalog items already carry a negotiated source, so the buyer's role is largely to confirm it rather than source from scratch, unlike a non-catalog request.

questions.q: What is consolidation, in the context of processing requisitions into purchase orders?
options: A step that only applies to canceling purchase orders
Merging two different suppliers into one supplier record
Combining a requisition and an invoice into one document
Combining multiple approved requisition lines, possibly from different requesters, that share a supplier, onto a single purchase order
questions.explain: Consolidation lets a buyer combine several requisition lines sharing a supplier onto one purchase order, reducing document volume and improving leverage.

questions.q: What is the difference between automated and manual processing of a requisition line into a purchase order?
options: Automated processing can generate a PO or add to an existing agreement based on defined rules; manual processing has a buyer review and build it by hand
There is no difference - all processing is identical
Automated processing is only available for service purchase orders
Manual processing skips the approval step entirely
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion supports both rule-driven automated processing and buyer-led manual processing of requisition lines into purchase orders.

questions.q: What is the status of the document Marcus creates at the end of this lesson?
options: A fully approved purchase order already sent to Meridian
A rejected requisition
A paid invoice
A draft standard purchase order referencing Dana's requisition line, not yet approved or sent
questions.explain: Processing the requisition produces a draft purchase order with Marcus as buyer - approval and supplier communication come later in Chapter 3.
